DECLARE @TidalJobNumber VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @TempTidalJobNumber VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @EnvironName VARCHAR(8000)
DECLARE @JobId INT

SET @TidalJobNumber = @0

SET @EnvironName = (SELECT Value FROM EPSDTAppConfig WHERE ConfigKey = 'Environment')
SET @JobId = (SELECT JobId FROM EPSDTJob WHERE JobCode = 'PostcardExport')

EXEC spCreateAppLog @JobId, 'JobRun', 'Start', 0, 0
EXEC spCreateAppLog @JobId, 'JobRun', 'Get Exclude Members', 0, 0

--if dev and running from visualstudio (instead of tidal), then put D in front
IF @EnvironName = 'Dev' AND @TidalJobNumber LIKE 'D%'
BEGIN
	SET @TempTidalJobNumber = (SELECT MAX(TidalJobNumber) FROM EPSDTJobFile WHERE TidalJobNumber LIKE 'D%')
	SET @TidalJobNumber = 'D' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(ISNULL(CONVERT(INT, REPLACE(@TempTidalJobNumber, 'D', '')) + 1, 1))))
END

SELECT
	TidalJobNumber = @TidalJobNumber

source.sqlReaderQuery: SELECT DISTINCT  	LTRIM(RTRIM(S.SBSB_ID))+'00' AS MEMBER, 	M.MEME_LAST_NAME,  	M.MEME_FIRST_NAME,  	'GA' AS MARKET, 	GETDATE() AS LoadDate FROM ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG E  INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_MEME_MEMBER M ON E.MEME_CK = M.MEME_CK  INNER JOIN ODW.DW.FAC_CMC_SBSB_SUBSC S ON M.SBSB_CK = S.SBSB_CK WHERE E.CSPI_ID IN  ('GALIMF04','GALIMF05','GAFP0000','GAFPIPC0','GASSIRMO','GAFSTCR0','GAFSTCPW','GAFSTWV0','GADJJ000','GADJJPW0','GADJJWV0','GAFCWVPW','GADJWVPW')  AND E.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y'

DECLARE @JobId INT
DECLARE @Path VARCHAR(8000)

SET @JobId = (SELECT JobId FROM EPSDTJob WHERE JobCode = 'PostcardExport')
SET @Path = dbo.fnGetExportPathFileName(@JobId, 0, 0) 

SELECT @JobId, @Path
DELETE FROM EPSDTJobFile WHERE JobId = @JobId AND TidalJobNumber = @TidalJobNumber AND CONVERT(DATE,CreateDateTime) <> CONVERT(DATE,GETDATE())
